notes: §2002:15.18.2 AR3 'If argument-2 is omitted, the function shall be evaluated as though 50 were specified for argument-2': the general format admits argument-3 only after argument-2, so each pair omits argument-3 too and both take the same year of execution (§2002:15.18.2 AR5); (600101) = (600101, 50), (760101) = (760101, 50), (770101) = (770101, 50) -> SAME x3, in any year. YY 60 separates 50 from 0 in 2010-2049; in 2026 YY 76/77 sit on the window edge (max-year 2076), so a default of 49 or 51 would change OMIT2B or OMIT2C. Run at --std 2002 with the pinned build dc1f2dcce8: output equals the derivation.
